literature.title: Intravenous dexketoprofen versus paracetamol in non-traumatic musculoskeletal pain in the emergency department: A randomized clinical trial.
literature.journal: The American journal of emergency medicine
literature.abstract: Although acute musculoskeletal pain has a wide range of causes from tendinitis, muscle spasm, to bone and joint injuries, it is a frequent occurrence in emergency services. Paracetamol and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (NSAID) are common used in the treatment of musculoskeletal pain. This study sets out to compare the effectiveness of intravenous dexketoprofen and paracetamol in musculoskeletal pain relief.

classification.study_type: RCT/Comparative Study (IV Dexketoprofen vs Paracetamol，非創傷性肌肉骨骼痛，急診)

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 肌腱炎核心病理為前列腺素 E2 介導的局部發炎反應，NSAID 抑制 COX-2 可減少肌腱局部 PGE2，改善疼痛與腫脹；機轉明確，Dexketoprofen 作為高效 NSAID 具合理理論基礎。
纖維肌痛症主要機轉為中樞敏感化（central sensitization），而非周邊前列腺素炎症；NSAIDs 對中樞敏感化效果有限，機轉關聯弱。相較之下，SNRIs、gabapentinoids 具更佳機轉匹配。
肌炎纖維化為慢性纖維化過程，NSAID 的前列腺素抑制機轉主要對急性炎症有效，對纖維化重塑（TGF-β 介導）效果有限，機轉關聯弱。
肉芽腫性肌炎屬免疫介導疾病，治療主軸為免疫調節（類固醇、DMARDs）；COX 抑制的前列腺素路徑在肉芽腫形成中非主要驅動機轉，Dexketoprofen 機轉關聯極弱。
RA 的關節滑膜炎症與 COX-2 過度表現相關；NSAIDs（包含 Dexketoprofen）可抑制 PGE2 減輕關節疼痛與僵硬，為 RA 症狀管理輔助藥物。然此屬類別外推，無 Dexketoprofen 特定 RA 數據。

literature.abstract: Migraine is a common, very disabling pain condition: the occurrence of an acute attack often requires bedrest and prevents from participating in normal activities. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs are widely used in the symptomatic treatment of migraine. Aim of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of a potent new formulation, dexketoprofen trometamol (DT), in the treatment of migraine pain.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 腦幹先兆型偏頭痛（前稱基底型偏頭痛）屬偏頭痛亞型，前列腺素介導的神經敏感化機轉仍適用；多項 Frovatriptan + Dexketoprofen 組合研究專針對此亞型或先兆型偏頭痛，且 Phase II RCT 存在。
骨疣（exostosis）為骨性增生結構問題，NSAID 可緩解繼發性疼痛但無法影響骨質增生病理；Dexketoprofen 在此缺乏修飾疾病機轉，僅有症狀緩解潛力，且無臨床證據支持。
先天性少毛症合併粟粒疹（congenital hypotrichosis milia）為遺傳性皮膚發育異常，與毛囊/皮膚附屬器發育基因相關；COX 抑制無已知的毛囊或囊腫發育修飾機轉，機轉關聯不明。
